data.gender_notes: Yashit is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Yashit is recorded with the meaning “Bringer of success”. Yashit is a Hindu name meaning “Bringer of success”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_marathi.name: Yashit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of success
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yashit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings success, accomplishment and triumph in all endeavors

in_bengali.name: Yashit
